LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A verified Antigravity flight run score record submitted by a pilot.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the pilot who recorded the flight.

pilotName.description: Public pilot callsign displayed on the leaderboard.

score.description: Total gravity wells evaded or disintegrated during the flight.

distance.description: Total astronomical units (AU) traveled during the flight.

nearMisses.description: Number of high-risk near-miss couplings performed during the flight.

difficultyTier.description: Highest gravitational surge difficulty tier reached.

isPublic.description: Indicates the flight record is published to the global leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the flight record was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the flight record was last updated.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public leaderboard records containing pilot performance metrics (score, distance, nearMisses, difficultyTier) with no PII.
